# `<sl-selectable-item>` — Selectable Item

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

A compact, checkable row for small selection lists, e.g. picking documents inside a dialog.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/selectable-item/selectable-item.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-checkbox>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | — | `string` | `''` | The value the item reports when selected, e.g. a document id. |
| `checked` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the item in a checked state. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the item, preventing selection. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-change` | — | Emitted when the user toggles the item's checked state. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The primary label, e.g. a document name. Truncates with an ellipsis when it overflows. |
| `meta` | A secondary value shown after the label, e.g. a date. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `checkbox` | The checkbox, an `<sl-checkbox>` element. |
| `checkbox__base` | The checkbox's exported `base` part. |
| `label` | The container that wraps the default slot. |
| `meta` | The container that wraps the meta slot. |

## Documentation and examples

Selectable items are lightweight rows for small selection lists — smaller than a full [table row](table-row.md),
and meant to live inside things like a dialog. Each one wraps an [`sl-checkbox`](checkbox.md), a primary
label in the default slot, and an optional secondary value in the `meta` slot.

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem;">
  <sl-selectable-item value="doc-1" checked>
    Statement of Work.pdf
    <span slot="meta">Oct 3, 2026</span>
  </sl-selectable-item>
  <sl-selectable-item value="doc-2">
    Amendment 1.pdf
    <span slot="meta">Sep 18, 2026</span>
  </sl-selectable-item>
  <sl-selectable-item value="doc-3" disabled>
    Signature Page.pdf
    <span slot="meta">Aug 2, 2026</span>
  </sl-selectable-item>
</div>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/selectable-item/selectable-item.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-selectable-item-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem;">
      <sl-selectable-item value="doc-1" checked>
        Statement of Work.pdf
        <span slot="meta">Oct 3, 2026</span>
      </sl-selectable-item>
      <sl-selectable-item value="doc-2">
        Amendment 1.pdf
        <span slot="meta">Sep 18, 2026</span>
      </sl-selectable-item>
      <sl-selectable-item value="doc-3" disabled>
        Signature Page.pdf
        <span slot="meta">Aug 2, 2026</span>
      </sl-selectable-item>
    </div>
  `
})
export class SelectableItemExampleComponent {}
```

The label truncates with an ellipsis when it's too long for the row, and the whole row is clickable, not just the
checkbox.

## Examples

### Listening for changes

Selecting or clearing an item emits `sl-change`. Combine multiple items to build a small selection list.

```html
<div class="selectable-item-list" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem;">
  <sl-selectable-item value="doc-1">
    Statement of Work.pdf
    <span slot="meta">Oct 3, 2026</span>
  </sl-selectable-item>
  <sl-selectable-item value="doc-2">
    Amendment 1.pdf
    <span slot="meta">Sep 18, 2026</span>
  </sl-selectable-item>

  <p style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">Selected: <strong class="selectable-item-list__value">none</strong></p>
</div>

<script>
  const list = document.querySelector('.selectable-item-list');
  const output = list.querySelector('.selectable-item-list__value');

  list.addEventListener('sl-change', () => {
    const selected = [...list.querySelectorAll('sl-selectable-item')]
      .filter(item => item.checked)
      .map(item => item.value);

    output.textContent = selected.length ? selected.join(', ') : 'none';
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/selectable-item/selectable-item.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, signal } from '@angular/core';

interface Doc {
  value: string;
  name: string;
  date: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-selectable-item-listening-for-changes-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem;">
      @for (doc of docs; track doc.value) {
        <sl-selectable-item
          [value]="doc.value"
          [checked]="checked().includes(doc.value)"
          (sl-change)="handleChange(doc.value, $event)"
        >
          {{ doc.name }}
          <span slot="meta">{{ doc.date }}</span>
        </sl-selectable-item>
      }

      <p style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">Selected: <strong>{{ summary() }}</strong></p>
    </div>
  `
})
export class SelectableItemListeningForChangesExampleComponent {
  readonly docs: Doc[] = [
    { value: 'doc-1', name: 'Statement of Work.pdf', date: 'Oct 3, 2026' },
    { value: 'doc-2', name: 'Amendment 1.pdf', date: 'Sep 18, 2026' }
  ];

  readonly checked = signal<string[]>([]);
  readonly summary = computed(() => (this.checked().length ? this.checked().join(', ') : 'none'));

  // sl-change bubbles, so one listener on a wrapper would also work. Per item it is clearer, and the item's own
  // `checked` property is the source of truth — read it off the event target rather than toggling blind.
  handleChange(value: string, event: Event) {
    const isChecked = (event.target as HTMLElement & { checked: boolean }).checked;
    this.checked.update(current => (isChecked ? [...current, value] : current.filter(v => v !== value)));
  }
}
```
